result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual/content problems: a spelling error in the search placeholder, an awkwardly cut-off category chip, and truncation issues in the horizontal restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The search bar placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restarants' is a misspelling of 'Restaurants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder text to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: A category filter chip at the far right (after 'Healthy') is cut off at the screen edge and appears empty, with no visible label, making it look broken rather than like a scrollable list.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the partially visible chip shows at least part of its label, signaling horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' is truncated without an ellipsis, and its card is clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add text truncation with an ellipsis or allow the name to wrap; ensure card peeking is intentional and consistent.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is cut off mid-image by the bottom navigation bar with no name/details visible, which can look abrupt.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/inset to the scroll content so cards aren't obscured by the fixed navigation bar, or add a subtle gradient/fade to indicate more content below.
